# Introduction {.unnumbered}

**Unit 4: Using AI Well** (Weeks 7-11)

The heart of the class. You will learn how to ask AI good questions, use it to help with writing, research, translation, math, and art, and finish a real project that uses AI to do something useful in your life. We will have time to revise, get feedback, and do the work right.

***

## What You'll Learn

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

* Write clear prompts and improve them
* Use AI to help with writing, research, translation, math, and art
* Check AI's work before you use it
* Finish a real project that uses AI to do something useful in your life
